says.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Zoey Albrecht. Trail crew lead. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Oath Ring, Mixtape, Coat button, Dog tags, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked
